constant.description: Constant to store the verbiage of the transfer confirmation form

value.el:
CPA License

Professional License Certification Form

Firm policy requires all Audit Managers, Senior Managers, Partners, and Tax & Advisory Professionals who are CPA eligible, to have a current, active CPA license to practice in the state in which his/her office is located. For any rotational transferring to NYC, it is mandatory that you complete the application and submit all required documentation to the NY State Board of Accountancy before you begin your rotation. Please be aware that licensure in New York State can take several months. Once your license has been awarded, please submit the documentation to the HRSC. For those as applicable, we ask that you hold off on starting this process at this time until communicated to do so by the DPP Operations team.
Independence

Independence Notice for Senior Managers and Managers in DPP

Independence Notice for Partners and Audit Managing Directors in DPP

Managers and above are required to complete an Independence Affidavit as part of joining the Department. Upon your start date with the department, you will receive a link to the Independence Affidavit which is required to be completed within 5 business days.
Transitional Core End Date Agreement

At the end of the 2 year transitional period, a determination by the transferee and DPP will be made as to whether the transferee becomes permanent core within DPP or returns back to their home BU/office.
